name: General knowledge (AI-written, not yet reviewed)
description: 33 questions on general knowledge, written by Claude. Every question and answer needs checking by a person before anybody plays it.

source.name: Written by hand by Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) on 2026-10-03, from its own knowledge: no API call and no source document. NOT checked against a source.

review.how: Check every question, answer and explanation. Fix or delete what is wrong, set status to 'reviewed' with your name and the date, then move the file to packs/ and list it in pack_library.js.

items.question: How many days are in a week?
items.explain: A week has seven days, Sunday through Saturday.

items.question: How many months are in a year?
items.explain: The year runs from January to December, which is twelve months.

items.question: What color do you get by mixing red and white?
items.explain: White lightens red, and light red is pink.

items.question: Which is the largest planet in our solar system?
items.explain: Jupiter is bigger than all the other planets put together.

items.question: How many minutes are in an hour?
items.explain: An hour is sixty minutes.

items.question: What sweet food do bees make?
items.explain: Bees make honey from the nectar of flowers.

items.question: How many sides does a triangle have?
items.explain: Tri means three: a triangle has three sides.

items.question: What do we call water when it freezes solid?
items.explain: Water turns to ice when it gets cold enough to freeze.

items.question: In which direction does the sun rise?
items.explain: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

items.question: How many hours are in a day?
items.explain: One full day, midnight to midnight, is twenty-four hours.

items.question: What is the opposite of hot?
items.explain: Hot and cold are opposites.

items.question: Which instrument has black and white keys?
items.explain: A piano is played by pressing its black and white keys.

items.question: How many players does a baseball team have on the field?
items.explain: A baseball team fields nine players: the pitcher, the catcher and seven others.

items.question: What is the capital of the United States?
items.explain: Washington, D.C. has been the capital since 1800.

items.question: On which continent are the pyramids of Giza?
items.explain: Giza is in Egypt, in the north of Africa.

items.question: How many cents are in a dollar?
items.explain: A dollar is one hundred cents.

items.question: Who was the first President of the United States?
items.explain: George Washington became the first President in 1789.

items.question: How many stars are on the flag of the United States?
items.explain: There is one star for each of the fifty states.

items.question: Which gas in the air do people need to breathe?
items.explain: Our bodies use the oxygen in the air we breathe in.

items.question: At sea level, water boils at how many degrees Fahrenheit?
items.explain: Water boils at 212 degrees Fahrenheit, which is 100 degrees Celsius.

items.question: Which month has the fewest days?
items.explain: February has 28 days, or 29 in a leap year.

items.question: What shape has four equal sides and four square corners?
items.explain: A square has four sides of the same length and four right angles.

items.question: In which country is the Eiffel Tower?
items.explain: The Eiffel Tower stands in Paris, France.

items.question: Tokyo is the capital city of which country?
items.explain: Tokyo is the capital of Japan.

items.question: What is the main language spoken in Brazil?
items.explain: Brazil was settled by Portugal, so most Brazilians speak Portuguese.

items.question: How many years are in a century?
items.explain: A century is one hundred years.

items.question: What do we call a word that means the opposite of another word?
items.explain: Hot and cold are antonyms; a synonym means the same thing instead.

items.question: Which metal is a liquid at room temperature?
items.explain: Mercury is the only metal that is liquid at ordinary room temperature.

items.question: How many sides does a hexagon have?
items.explain: Hex means six: a hexagon has six sides, like a honeycomb cell.

items.question: What is the largest country in the world by area?
items.explain: Russia is the biggest country by land, stretching across Europe and Asia.

items.question: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
items.explain: Rusty dust on its surface makes Mars look red.

items.question: Who painted the Mona Lisa?
items.explain: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa in Italy in the early 1500s.

items.question: How many inches are in a foot?
items.explain: One foot is twelve inches.
